name: scene-1
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. ONE 1024x1536 portrait coloring page for a FOUR-YEAR-OLD, based faithfully on the supplied playful scene. Small PinPin hedgehog on the left reaches one paw up to gently lift a single BIG oak leaf off the quills beside the Elder's head. Larger Elder hedgehog on the right wears clear round glasses and smiles at the child. Their faces look at each other; leaf held between their faces above the Elder's shoulder, away from glasses. Show both whole characters with natural separate paws and feet, large on page. Simplify background to one broad curved root arch and a plain ground line; no leaf litter, rug patterns, flowers or furniture. BLACK bold smooth outlines on completely OPAQUE PURE WHITE #FFFFFF paper. Fill every region and background white, no transparency. Huge closed fillable shapes for thick crayons; quills a zigzag outer silhouette and a few very large inside shapes; oak leaf few broad lobes with only central vein. No grey, color, tonal shading, gradients, texture, hatching, shadows, fine fur, dense needles, words, text, numbers or border. Tiny black pupils and nose details permitted. Friendly expressive faces, generous page margin.

review.notes: Clear affectionate leaf removal, correct glasses and separate paws, large blank areas and no text.
